// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The read the schools list is actually for. Named columns only, a school-level
// relation count of adult records, and nothing that reaches a child.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function listSchoolsForOps() {
  return db.school.findMany({
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      createdAt: true,
      _count: { select: { staff: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
}
